purpose: Immutable record of every reference-rubric digest ever declared for the GNER-E1 equal-workload study (issue #1081). study.py enforces the active revision's digest before P1/P2 and fails closed on mismatch. Changing labels requires appending a revision with a justification; silently accepting a different digest is not allowed.

revisions.justification: These are the only rubric bytes that were ever executed (P1/P2/P3 in run 41132149131 and in the local reproduction). Registering them records, rather than hides, that they differ from the predeclared revision-0 digest. Acceptance of the labels themselves remains with the human/domain referee; every case is PENDING in the oracle packet.
